messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: auto-dif refs
parts:
The cleanest refs I've found for auto-dif are the following.
This one's clearly the basis for the discussion on Wikipedia, but
there's more on the handout:

http://www.pvv.ntnu.no/~berland/resources/autodiff-triallecture.pdf

This one's particularly nice in terms of notational development
and application to matrix ops:

http://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/gilesm/files/AD2008.pdf

This is where we need to go next for efficiency of multivariate
models -- that is, do all the solvers, etc., on double matrices.
Shouldn't be too hard given that there are decent ways to do

B / A = B * A^{-1}

and

A \ B = A^{-1} * B

so we can still avoid inverses even in the auto-dif calcs.

- Bob
